verified_claims.statement: QI-C1 achieves competitive predictive performance with classical GA control on real vessel telemetry (MAE = 237.96 ± 5.46 kg/h vs 237.24 ± 4.89 kg/h, Wilcoxon p = 0.684).
verified_claims.evidence: 30-seed matched benchmark protocol; exact 6 canonical QIEA features on 34,796 test samples.

verified_claims.statement: QIEA quantum-inspired representation provides +44.7% higher population bit-entropy diversity compared to standard binary genetic algorithms.
verified_claims.evidence: QIEA average bit entropy H_bit = 0.2814 vs Classical GA H_bit = 0.2104 over feature search iterations.

verified_claims.statement: Split conformal prediction delivers empirical coverage (93.56% for QI-C1, 95.05% for MODEL-REAL-04) exceeding the nominal 90% floor.
verified_claims.evidence: Calibrated on 34,794 validation samples and tested on 34,796 temporal test samples.

verified_claims.statement: QI-C1 produces 31.17% narrower conformal prediction intervals (MPIW = 1,564.93 kg/h vs 2,273.70 kg/h) than MODEL-REAL-04 on held-out test data.
verified_claims.evidence: Conformal quantile q_hat = 782.47 kg/h (QI-C1) vs 1,136.85 kg/h (MODEL-REAL-04).

verified_claims.statement: The primary OOD guard achieves 0.0% false-positive rate on evaluated real in-domain test data and 96.55% recall on severe out-of-distribution states at d_env = 1.50.
verified_claims.evidence: Evaluated across 2,000 real in-domain records (TN=2000, FP=0) and 666 severe synthetic OOD scenarios (TP=643, FN=23).

verified_claims.statement: Software safety defenses safely intercept 1,000/1,000 malformed inputs, 16/16 edge cases, and 10/10 injected runtime failures.
verified_claims.evidence: Automated stress tests and failure injection matrix in scripts/release_gate.py.

verified_claims.statement: Fleet optimization objective incorporates non-zero penalty gap distinguishing penalized optimum (873.2265 t) from pure physical grid minimum (3.2369 t).
verified_claims.evidence: Phase 5 frozen benchmark of 825,000 evaluations across 5 algorithms.

verified_claims.statement: Matrix Product States (MPS) tensor network prediction was unviable under tested training configuration due to optimization divergence and is preserved as an honest negative finding.
verified_claims.evidence: Negative research result documented in docs/limitations.md and test_mps_predictor.py.

verified_with_qualification_claims.statement: Slow steaming operational policy reduces simulated fuel consumption by up to 24.8% to 35.5%.
verified_with_qualification_claims.qualification: Scenario-specific simulated result under stated operating assumptions and cubic propulsion physics; depends on speed reduction magnitude and schedule slack.

verified_with_qualification_claims.statement: Alternative fuel evaluation quantifies mass flow and greenhouse gas emissions for Bio-Methanol, Green Ammonia, and Liquid Hydrogen.
verified_with_qualification_claims.qualification: Evaluated via thermodynamic energy equivalence (invariant shaft work E = P_B * t); alternative fuel telemetry is not in the original dataset and represents scenario simulation.

verified_with_qualification_claims.statement: OOD guard balanced accuracy across the complete synthetic benchmark is 66.09%.
verified_with_qualification_claims.qualification: Modest and moderate environmental extrapolations are intentionally permitted through with inflated uncertainty; severe OOD is intercepted with 96.55% recall.

rejected_claims.prohibited_term: quantum supremacy / quantum computer / quantum advantage
rejected_claims.rationale: The system runs on classical hardware using classical probabilistic quantum-inspired metaheuristics (QIEA, QPSO). No quantum hardware or quantum speedup is claimed.

rejected_claims.prohibited_term: universally superior QI model / QI beats classical ML
rejected_claims.rationale: Statistical test (Wilcoxon p = 0.684) proves statistical parity, not superiority, over classical GA control.

rejected_claims.prohibited_term: autonomous vessel controller / certified autonomous system
rejected_claims.rationale: System is strictly a decision-support advisory prototype requiring human-in-the-loop validation; it has not received maritime class certification.

rejected_claims.prohibited_term: green fuel telemetry / measured hydrogen consumption
rejected_claims.rationale: Vessel dataset contains only conventional marine fuel telemetry (VLSFO, MGO). Green fuel figures are thermodynamic scenario simulations.

rejected_claims.prohibited_term: zero-gap physical optimum / guaranteed fuel savings
rejected_claims.rationale: Real fleet optimization incorporates schedule penalty cliffs; exact physical minimum differs from penalized constrained optimum.
Software safety validation passes all evaluated test suites, but absolute safety cannot be guaranteed under unmodeled physical extremes.
